data.one_liner: A simple Flutter widget to apply a stroke or border style to text.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single-purpose widget called StrokeText that renders text with custom stroke colors and stroke widths. It also supports text styling, text alignment, and maximum lines.
use_when: You need to display text with an outlined border or stroke effect in Flutter.
You want a quick way to customize text stroke width and color without complex custom painters.
avoid_when: You need complex text animations or rich text formatting beyond basic text styles.
strengths: Easy to integrate and use with familiar TextStyle parameters.
Supports customizable stroke color and width.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic text stroking.
No advanced text effects or rich text builder support documented.
data.minimal_example:
StrokeText(
  text: "Flutter",
  textStyle: TextStyle(
    fontSize: 50,
    color: Colors.green
  ),
  strokeColor: Colors.amber,
  strokeWidth: 5,
)
